rhs_question_text:
A conservation charity has scientists working from home and field offices. They query large datasets that include confidential information. The charity is comparing two designs:
• Thin client: user machines mainly collect input and show results; virtual machines on a central server do the main processing, and storage is presented virtually.
• Thick client: most processing runs on researchers' own computers, using specialist software that accesses central data.
